purpose: First-party figures cited on /blog/ecnl-vs-mls-next, /blog/ecnl-vs-npl, /blog/what-is-ecnl. Any figure in prose that is not in this file is unsourced and must be removed or re-derived.

credential_note.access: Queried via Supabase PostgREST using NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY from frontend/.env.local. scripts/blog_research.py:25 loads a repo-root .env expecting DATABASE_URL, which C:/PitchRank/.env does not define - that path will not work for a re-run.
credential_note.tls_note: curl required --ssl-revoke-best-effort on this machine: Norton TLS interception makes schannel fail cert revocation checking (CRYPT_E_NO_REVOCATION_CHECK). Certificate validation itself still applies.
credential_note.env_file_note: frontend/.env.local begins with a UTF-8 BOM, so `source .env.local` fails; parse with sed 's/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//' first.

figure_A_total_teams.definition: homepage-cache definition: active, non-deprecated, ranked teams
figure_A_total_teams.sql_equivalent: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.rankings_full rf JOIN public.teams t ON t.team_id_master = rf.team_id WHERE rf.status = 'Active' AND t.is_deprecated IS NOT TRUE AND rf.power_score_final IS NOT NULL

cache_cross_check.note: refreshed_at matches the documented pg_cron schedule '13 8 * * *' (08:13 UTC daily).

figure_A_total_teams.rounding_rule: publish the LOWER of recompute and cache, rounded DOWN to the nearest 1,000
figure_A_total_teams.fallback_ceiling_check: frontend/lib/stats.ts:13 FALLBACK_STATS.totalTeams = 59000. Published 58,000 is below both the live count and the fallback, so prose cannot overstate the on-site counter.

figure_B_league_mix.definition: league composition of the top 50 ranked teams at one age group and gender
figure_B_league_mix.sql_equivalent: SELECT league_group, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.league IN ('MLS_NEXT_HD','MLS_NEXT_AD') THEN 'MLS_NEXT' ELSE t.league END, 'UNAFFILIATED') AS league_group FROM public.rankings_full rf JOIN public.teams t ON t.team_id_master = rf.team_id WHERE rf.status='Active' AND t.is_deprecated IS NOT TRUE AND rf.power_score_final IS NOT NULL AND rf.age_group='u15' AND rf.gender=<gender> ORDER BY rf.power_score_final DESC LIMIT 50) top50 GROUP BY league_group ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
figure_B_league_mix.case_notes: age_group is lowercase ('u15'); gender is title-case ('Male'/'Female'). Both verified against live data returning 50 rows.

u15_male.coverage_gate: PASS - UNAFFILIATED 18% is below the 30% sparse-coverage threshold
u15_male.prose_form: about three in five of the top 50 U15 boys teams play in MLS NEXT

u15_female.coverage_gate: PASS - UNAFFILIATED 4% is below the 30% sparse-coverage threshold
u15_female.prose_form: about seven in ten of the top 50 U15 girls teams play in ECNL

figure_B_league_mix.interpretation_permitted: The boys and girls top ends are concentrated in different leagues - a structural observation about where strong teams currently sit.
figure_B_league_mix.interpretation_forbidden: Not a measure of league quality; not generalizable past u15, which is the only age group queried.

staleness_guidance: Rankings republish every Monday, so exact counts drift. Prose uses proportional phrasing ('about three in five') rather than raw counts so the pages do not go stale weekly. Re-run both queries before materially changing any figure.
